verdict: A tough week — spend pulled back sharply and lead volume followed.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 130 leads, all delivered by Meta, at a cost per lead of $19.85 — up 29% from the prior week as a sharp reduction in Google Ads spend left Meta carrying the full load. Google Ads consumed $1,239.78 this period with no recorded conversions, and over the most recent three days daily spend averaged just $17.50 versus $100.30 in the three days prior, signalling the pullback is still in motion. To stabilise volume, Google campaign structure is being reviewed and the budget allocation between channels is being addressed. New paid landing pages and a fresh creative batch are both scheduled for delivery by end of August, which should give Meta stronger assets to work with heading into September.
